description:
## Dual VoT Patches 1.49.0-dev.7-dualvot.8.5.4

Fix the Yandex playback crash caused by missing kotlin.Unit and Function1 on Java-only Morphe bases. Player callbacks no longer link to Kotlin classes. Preserve pause/resume and PiP listener removal.

Regression tests include a runtime with no Kotlin classes. Android device confirmation is pending.
